name: Webrazzi

sources.title: Webrazzi - Pitch Your Startup form page
Webrazzi English edition homepage (Turkish tech/startup media)

requirements: This is an editorial pitch, not a guaranteed listing: 'If you would like your startup to be featured on Webrazzi, you can fill out this form'
The form is explicitly 'used for new startup review only' - news tips about an already-covered startup go to the authors by email instead
Webrazzi is a Turkish tech media outlet with an English edition; Turkish-language page equivalent exists at /girisim-formu
preparation: Startup name, website, and a concise pitch suitable for editorial review
Founder/contact details and any traction metrics the form asks for
Have a Turkish-friendly angle or regional relevance ready - Webrazzi's core audience is the Turkish/EMEA startup ecosystem
For news (not first-time review): use the editorial contact email shown on the form page instead
workflow: Wait for the embedded form to load - the page renders 'Form yükleniyor...' (Turkish for 'form loading') while the form iframe/JS initializes
Complete and submit the startup review form
If pitching news about an existing startup rather than a first review, email the editorial contact instead (address on the form page, Cloudflare-obfuscated)
watchFor: The form body is JS-loaded ('Form yükleniyor...') - a non-JS fetch shows no fields; use a real browser
Submitting through this form does NOT guarantee coverage - it enters an editorial review queue
Do not use this form for press-release-style news; the page routes those to a different contact
No paid option is advertised on the form page; advertising enquiries go through /en/advertise/
countsAsLive: An editorial article or startup profile about the company is published on webrazzi.com (news or startups section) - there is no self-serve listing page
unknowns: Exact form fields (rendered by JS and not publicly inspectable without running the page)
Editorial response time and acceptance rate
Whether an English-language pitch is acceptable or Turkish is preferred
